title: Add Edge Weaver RAG quickstart with streaming dev-proxy and auth shim
author: Soraya Patel
release_notes: Introduce an Edge Weaver RAG quickstart that demonstrates streaming proxy, lightweight auth shim, and composable retrieval adapters for low-latency edge deployments.
description:
Context and motivation: This quickstart provides a compact, runnable example for teams looking to deploy RAG-style agents at the edge (edge VMs, CDN workers, or lambda-edge-like runtimes). The goal is to show a pragmatic low-latency pattern that combines a tiny streaming dev-proxy, a token-auth shim (KMS-compatible), and a pluggable retrieval adapter that can run locally or call a hosted vector store. This helps customers validate latency budgets and exercise prefix caching and streaming behavior before committing to Dedicated/Private deployments.

What this PR delivers (high level): - new quickstart scaffold under quickstarts/edge-weaver-rag/ with runnable examples and step-by-step README - streaming proxy that demonstrates chunked SSE/HTTP2 responses and transparent retry hooks - a minimal auth shim that demonstrates KMS-wrapped keys and short-lived tokens for edge usage (dev-only by default) - a composable retrieval adapter interface with two implementations: local in-memory index and remote vector store adapter (mocked) - CI smoke workflow for the quickstart that builds the proxy, runs lint, and executes 3 end-to-end smoke scenarios in a headless container (local index + mock tool calls)

Files changed (summary): see files_changed list for exact paths. No runtime code changes to the core inference runtime are included; this is purely quickstart tooling + docs + small dev proxy.

Checklist: - [x] README with step-by-step local run instructions and examples for streaming and non-streaming flows - [x] Example config for toggling remote vs local retrieval adapters - [x] CI smoke tests that run in GitHub Actions and on self-hosted runners - [x] Documentation snippets added to docs-site reference page under "Quickstarts -> Edge" - [x] Security note in README describing dev-only nature of the auth shim and instructions to swap in customer KMS/HSM for production

Commits (high level): - feat: scaffolding for quickstart and README - feat: streaming dev-proxy implementation (SSE + chunked HTTP2) - feat: auth-shim with KMS-wrapped dev key and token issuance endpoint - feat: retrieval-adapter interface + local and mock-remote impls - test: add CI smoke workflow and step definitions - docs: edge quickstarts index entry and short tutorial snippet

Changed areas / notable snippets: - quickstarts/edge-weaver-rag/README.md (new, contains quickstart runbook, diagrams, and safety notes) - quickstarts/edge-weaver-rag/proxy/streaming-proxy.js (simple Node 18 server demonstrating chunked responses and backpressure-aware writes) - quickstarts/edge-weaver-rag/auth/shim.js (dev-only token issuer showing KMS unwrap pattern) - quickstarts/edge-weaver-rag/adapters/index.js (adapter interface) - quickstarts/edge-weaver-rag/adapters/local-index.js (in-memory SQLite-backed prefix + vector index shim) - quickstarts/edge-weaver-rag/.github/workflows/quickstart-smoke.yml (CI smoke) - docs/quickstarts/edge.md (docs site entry, short)

Review conversation snapshot: - Evan Carter (requested changes): "Nice shape. Please split the streaming proxy logic into two files: transport and handler. The proxy file is doing too much and that's going to make it hard to test the backpressure path." \nAuthor reply: "Split transport/handler and added unit tests for the transport wrapper (tests/transport.test.js). PTAL." \n- Marta Kuznetsova (comment): "Auth shim looks fine for dev. Please add explicit instructions in the README for replacing the dev KMS key with a customer-managed key and point out token TTL impacts on edge warm starts." \nAuthor reply: "Added KMS replacement section and a small table showing TTL tradeoffs and cold start latency impacts." \n- Diego Alvarez (approval): "Approach LGTM; smoke CI passed on runner. Small nit: call out that the mock remote adapter intentionally returns deterministic vectors for deterministic E2E tests." \n
CI summary: initial runs failed due to linting errors in streaming-proxy.js (long lines and an unused helper). Fixed in second commit. Final CI run: all checks passed (lint, unit tests, smoke-e2e).

Merge notes: Squash-merged after approvals from Evan and Diego. No follow-up migration required. The quickstart is gated behind docs-only changes for the docs site and a new quickstarts index entry; no runtime or customer-facing API was changed.
